title: lophophora williamsii var. koehresii
intro: Lophophora williamsii var. koehresii, commonly known as a variant of the peyote cactus, is a species of cactus native to Mexico and the southwestern United States. It is valued for its health benefits, which include pain relief, reduced inflammation, and improved sleep quality, likely due to its therapeutic actions as a natural analgesic and sedative. The bioactive constituents of Lophophora williamsii var. koehresii include a range of alkaloids, including mescaline, peyocactin, and anhalonidine, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. However, it is essential to note that the plant is a controlled substance in many countries and should be used with caution and under the guidance of a healthcare professional.
